questions.question: Viewer reads: she stays for one cup before she goes - carried by: IRIS, empty wooden chair

1-3s ACTION: does this happen on screen - IRIS sits down in the empty chair?
3-5.5s ACTION: does this happen on screen - IRIS speaks to HAL; HAL nods slowly?
5.5-8s HOLD: does this happen on screen - both sit still as the window brightens?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): IRIS sits down in the empty chair
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): HAL nods slowly
IRIS: does the face/body read as decided, warm (restrained)? Must NOT read as: sadness.
HAL: does the face/body read as relieved (restrained)? Must NOT read as: tears.
Line 59 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: IRIS: One cup. Then I go.
IRIS sounds like the voice bible: quiet clear female voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size WIDE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

Last frame matches state SC06_end: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS seated across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Line 59: does IRIS clearly speak to HAL (eyes and body toward them)?
Is HAL in frame for the whole clip?
Does IRIS look at HAL and never into the lens?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look.
